objective: Complete fixture acquisition, Qwen3-ASR offline/streaming evaluation, predefined ablations, evidence generation, and final disposition without ad-hoc iterative repair.

states.name: dependency_bootstrap
conditions: qwen-asr missing => bootstrap offline dependency once
vLLM missing => attempt streaming dependency only on supported Linux/CUDA runtime

states.name: predefined_ablations
conditions: context harm => offending context source disabled and paired rerun once
semantic mutation => reject normalization without rerun

branch_actions.STOP_FIXTURE_CONTRACT_INVALID: write exact schema violation; no fixture download
branch_actions.STOP_PUBLIC_FIXTURE_BLOCKED: preserve download/reference evidence; no ASR claims
branch_actions.MARK_CODE_SWITCH_BLOCKED_AND_CONTINUE: run EN/JA/general/technical suites; code-switch AC explicitly BLOCKED
branch_actions.STOP_ENV_BLOCKED: record runtime delta; no code mutation
branch_actions.MARK_RELEVANT_BACKEND_BLOCKED_AND_CONTIN: offline may continue without vLLM; streaming never falsely passes
branch_actions.CLASSIFY_PRECONDITION_BRANCH: map to ENV/PACKAGE/MODEL/FIXTURE without threshold changes
branch_actions.CLASSIFY_MODEL_OR_ACCURACY_BRANCH: model-load failure=BLOCKED_MODEL; valid inference below AC=REFRAME_ACCURACY

closure_rule: CLOSED only when final disposition is PASS and every required evidence file exists. BLOCKED/REFRAME/REJECT remain OPEN with machine-readable branch and next executable condition.
